items.difficulty_reason: 41 行、对偶 + 逼近交换的标准论证：①命题改写成 Hom 层面的同构，用 perfect 生成元（bondal-van-den-Bergh，本线 L22125）把检验对象归到 perfect E；②lemma-Rlim-quasi-coherent 把 lim 换成 R lim，R Hom_X(E,-) 保积 ⇒ 保 derived limit，把极限移出 Hom；③对偶复形 E^vee + cohomology-base-change 引理（本线 L22122 的引用源、同章 L22121 姊妹）把 R Hom(X, O_X⊗M_n) 写成 RΓ(X, E^vee) ⊗ M_n；④proper f ⇒ RΓ(X, E^vee) 是 perfect（flat-proper-perfect-direct-image-general 引理）⇒ pseudo-coherent，套 more-algebra 的 pseudo-coherent tensor limit 引理完成交换。承重全在 span 内；7 处引用（4 同章、3 跨章）作导航桩。

primary.label: author lemma environment with its own label lemma-pullback-and-limits (no canonical tag in the snapshot tag list); statement at source lines 7785-7798

proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: the reformulation as an isomorphism of Hom groups tested on a perfect generator, the commutation of R Hom with products hence derived limits, the identification of R Hom against the pullback module with cohomology of the dual tensor the module via the base change lemma, the perfection of the global cohomology of the dual over a proper morphism, and the pseudo-coherent tensor limit lemma finishing the交换 (source lines 7800-7840)
